rules: Resolve nodes in the exact topological order below; unknown node kind, key, reference, patch, owner, or union arm is rejection.
OBJECT_REF values come only from reference_catalogue and are exact accepted ObjectRef triples.
QUANTITY uses IntegerV1 magnitude, the shared unit/dimension/boundary/resource/time/sign refs, PRESENT resolution, and NOT_APPLICABLE for service, region, and uncertainty.

The tokens $ref:key, $epoch:n, $duration:n, and $quantity:n resolve only through this document: refs expand to the exact catalogue triple; epochs and durations use $ref:clock plus IntegerV1(n); quantities use IntegerV1(n), quantity_context, and an exact PRESENT ResolutionDetail whose seven conditional/evidence fields are empty or NOT_APPLICABLE. JSON arrays become exact tuples in listed order; enum and literal strings resolve only from the declared field type.
RECORD_PAYLOAD projects every field after envelope in declared field order using accepted to_ecj1 projection rules.

COMMON_OBJECT_ENVELOPE nodes freeze object_id/object_kind_id/schema_id/version/authority/lifecycle metadata and deterministically derive canonical object_content_payload plus accepted ebu.object-content.v1 after payload patches; no stored hash occurs inside its own payload.

Every record baseline below contains the complete field map in exact declared order. Apply vector JSON-Pointer patches to baseline.payload before envelope construction, except route_guard patches which target baseline.call_state and fixture patches which first select the exact case_id row from fixture_inventory.payload then target that selected case; fixture /capability/* paths alone target the baseline capability node.
For negative constructor vectors attempt the exact constructor once after patching; any DELETE of a required field is I7_RECORD_FORMATION_INVALID and no later semantic predicate is active.

For callable vectors construct every named support record and invoke exactly the vector owner once with baseline.call_argument_order[owner]. Issue one exact allowlisted capability only for validate_dynamic_static_identity owner vectors. For _issue_t2_fixture_capability owner vectors, materialize its four keyword arguments from the patched capability node and invoke the issuer once without pre-issuing support.
No alias, registry lookup, dynamic import, callback, model, policy, runner, state transition, filesystem input other than the frozen fixture, or scientific result is available to the language.
